sources.title: ToxicSQL / LLM SQL injection study
sources.claim: Classical SQL injection detection drops from ~98% to 60% against LLM-generated queries

sources.title: Schema linking bidirectional survey
sources.claim: CHESS 97.12% recall / 30.57% FPR; RSL-SQL 93.28% / 68.23% FPR

sources.title: NL2SQL-Bugs benchmark
sources.claim: Average LLM detection accuracy 75.16%; 6.91% of BIRD gold set contains undetected semantic errors

sources.title: NL2SQL-Bugs paper (arXiv)
sources.claim: First benchmark for semantic errors in NL2SQL: 9-category taxonomy, 31 subcategories, 2,018 instances

sources.title: QueryShield: prevent SQL injection in LLM queries
sources.claim: Four-layer guardrail: AST parsing, statement-type allowlist, policy enforcement, evidence logging with signed timestamps

sources.title: Supabase pgvector HNSW benchmark
sources.claim: HNSW ~3x faster than IVFFlat on 224k 1536-dim vectors; 6x+ at 1M vectors at 0.98 accuracy

sources.title: PostgreSQL read-only enforcement (jkatz05)
sources.claim: default_transaction_read_only can be overridden in-session; role-level GRANT is the only true enforcement

sources.title: sqlglot — Python SQL parser
sources.claim: SQL parser supporting 31 dialects with full AST traversal and type inference

sources.title: pgvector — PostgreSQL vector extension
sources.claim: Supports HNSW and IVFFlat indexes, vector types up to 16k dims, hybrid SQL+ANN queries

sources.title: Vanna.AI — RAG text-to-SQL
sources.claim: Embeds DDL, documentation, and example SQL; retrieves 10 most relevant pieces at query time

sources.title: PostgreSQL predefined roles
sources.claim: pg_read_all_data role (PG 14+) grants SELECT on all tables without bypassing RLS policies

sources.title: AI SQL security: read replica as physical barrier
sources.claim: Read replica creates physical impossibility for DROP, DELETE, UPDATE regardless of injection

sources.title: Multi-tenant leakage: when RLS fails in SaaS
sources.claim: CVE-2024-10976 (RLS bypass below subqueries) and CVE-2025-8713 (statistics leaking RLS-hidden rows)

sources.title: ToxicSQL backdoor paper (arXiv)
sources.claim: 0.44% training data poisoning achieves 79.41% attack success rate for malicious SQL generation

sources.title: DataBrain: LLM SQL evaluation study
sources.claim: 50K+ production query study: most broken LLM queries execute successfully and return data

sources.title: CHESS: Contextual Schema Pruning
sources.claim: CHESS 97.12% schema recall via adaptive pruning; full schema input confuses LLMs — selective retrieval is crucial

sources.title: OWASP LLM Top 10 (2025)
sources.claim: Allowlists over blocklists; treat LLM output like user input — validate, sanitise, encode before use

sources.title: SQL agent safety architecture (Tim Dietrich)
sources.claim: 6 core controls: read-only replica, allowlisting, result size limits, deterministic validation, audit logging, sandboxed service account

sources.title: BIRD benchmark leaderboard
sources.claim: Top text-to-SQL accuracy: 81.95% (AskData+GPT-4o); human baseline 92.96%

sources.title: sqlparse — Python SQL tokenizer
sources.claim: Non-validating SQL parser for tokenization and statement splitting

sources.title: Text-to-SQL survey 2024 — schema linking across three eras
sources.claim: Schema linking more critical in LLM era due to input-length limits; groups methods into string-matching, neural, and in-context-learning eras
